decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Statement of Support, Photographs, Noise Impact Assessment, 13/163/Loc, 13/163/Sk01, 13/163/Sk02, 13/163/sk03 Received: 16 October 2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The level of noise emitted from the site shall not exceed 10dB below background noise level between the hours of 08:15 and 20:30 as measured from the nearest noise sensitive location.
Condition : 4 - Any external plant shall not operate outside the hours of 09:00 - 20:30 Monday - Thursday, 09:00 - 19:00 Friday, 08:15 - 18:00 Saturday and 08:15 - 20:30 Sunday.

Condition : 5 - Within three (3) months of the implementation of the acoustic enclosure and visual screening, a further noise impact assessment in accordance with BS4142:1997 shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The proposed acoustic enclosure and visual screening shall be maintained, repaired and replaced in accordance with approved drawing numbers 13/163/Loc, 13/163/Sk02, 13/163/sk03 received: 16 October 2013
description: Re-location of two existing air conditioning units to be housed within an acoustic enclosure complete with visual screening to the rear of the premises
